obligation: Port Java's backslash line-continuation join at Java's position in the reader chain, relative to TIM's removeInnerComment stage (round 4).

java_trace.pre_tim_merge: BlockUmlBuilder#<init>: ReadLineReader (BufferedReader#readLine: CRLF, CR and LF all end a line; BOM and U+2013 handled) -> preproc.UncommentReadLine -> preproc2.Preprocessor(ReadFilterAddConfig, ReadFilterMergeLines). Every line of the input passes ReadFilterMergeLines before BlockUmlBuilder looks for start/end directives and before BlockUml runs TIM (TimLoader -> TContext#executeLines -> buildCodeIterator it20 long comment, it30 short comment, it40 removeInnerComment, ...). So the join precedes every TIM stage, including round 4's removeInnerComment.
java_trace.merge_rule: preproc2.ReadFilterMergeLines#readLine: read result from the source. If result is a start directive (StartUtils#isStartDirective = DiagramType#findStartTypes non-empty: leading Character#isWhitespace, then '@' or '\\', then case-insensitive 'start' + type) whose types contain DITAA, manageEndingBackslash = false; if result is an end directive (StartUtils#isEndDirective: leading whitespace, '@' or '\\', then 'end'), manageEndingBackslash = true. While manageEndingBackslash and StringUtils#endsWithBackslash(result) (s.endsWith("\\") && !s.endsWith("\\\\")): next = ReadFilterQuoteComment-filtered readLine; null -> stop (the trailing backslash stays); else result = StringLocated#mergeEndBackslash(next) = s minus its last char + next.s, keeping result's LineLocation (the first line's number). Several continued lines chain in the same loop. Only lines read as 'result' are checked for start/end directives; a merged-in next line never is.
java_trace.continued_line_filter: preproc2.ReadFilterQuoteComment#readLine (new instance per merge, longComment local to each call): trim = s.replace('\t',' ').trim() (Java trim, chars <= U+0020). In a long comment, a line whose trim endsWith "'/" ends it; all its lines are skipped. trim startsWith "'" -> skipped. startsWith "/'" and endsWith "'/" -> skipped. startsWith "/'" without "'/" -> long comment starts, skipped. Otherwise the line is returned as StringLocated#removeInnerComment(). Comment lines between a continued line and its continuation are therefore skipped, and the continuation's inner comment is removed before the join. The first line (result) is NOT filtered: '/' c '/ \\' + 'A -> B : hi' joins to "/' c '/ A -> B : hi", and TIM it40 later strips the leading comment to ' A -> B : hi'.
java_trace.escaped_backslash: A line ending in \\\\ is not continued and is passed on unchanged (endsWithBackslash is false).
java_trace.eof_and_end_directive: If no next line exists the loop stops and the line keeps its backslash. If the next line is the end directive it is merged like any other line, so BlockUmlBuilder never sees the end and creates no BlockUml for it. In -pipe mode Pipe#readSingleDiagram cuts the input at the first raw line starting with '@end<type>' and appends '@end<type>' when none is present, so a continued last line always swallows the block's end; with zero blocks SourceStringReader#outputImage calls noValidStartFound ('No valid @start/@end found, please check the version').
java_trace.not_pre_tim_merged: TContext#executeInclude (file, URL, stdlib) and #executeIncludesub read through ReadLineReader (+UncommentReadLine for includesub) without ReadFilterMergeLines; theme.ThemeUtils loads themes through ReadLineReader only. Procedure, !define, !definelong and multiline command bodies written in the main source are already joined pre-TIM because the join runs on raw text.
java_trace.post_tim_join: PSystemBuilder#createPSystem: UmlSource.createWithRaw(source, findStartTypes(source.get(0)).contains(SEQUENCE), rawSource); UmlSource#loadInternal with checkEndingBackslash joins every TIM output line that endsWithBackslash with the following line(s) (pending.append(s, 0, len-1)), and the joined StringLocated takes the LAST piece's location. findStartTypes gives SEQUENCE only for @startuml, so this second join applies to every @startuml diagram (all UML families) and to no other start type. A pending tail at the end of the list is dropped. UmlSource#seed hashes the joined list (getPlainString), so SVG resource ids follow the joined source.
